title: Fragile
headline: In 1971, Rick Wakeman picked Yes over Bowie's band
caption:
Yes's Fragile, the album that gave us "Roundabout", came out in the UK 55 years ago this month, and there are two stories about where its name came from.

Bill Bruford says he suggested Fragile himself, because he believed the band was breakable at the time. Michael Tait, their lighting director, remembered it differently: the manager, Brian Lane, came up with it on a phone call with a journalist while looking at photos of the Crystal Palace show. The band's stage monitors had "Fragile" stamped on the back.

Either way, it was the band Rick Wakeman had just chosen over a spot in David Bowie's touring band.
